baselines.label_scope: All native fuzzy answer positions, including unseen terminal queries; dense training objective is separate.

oracle.interpretation: Prefix-only retrieval conditional on native scored positions; unavailable mappings abstain and count as errors. Coverage is not a statistical accuracy ceiling.

query_ignoring_answer_prefix.information_restriction: Earlier completed mappings and the teacher-forced current answer prefix only; input-run annotation selects reporting positions, not answers.
query_ignoring_answer_prefix.method: Among values of distinct earlier completed keys matching the visible current value prefix, predict the modal next token. Ignore current query identity. Empty candidate set uses the smallest value symbol absent from the visible value prefix.

query_ignoring_modal.information_restriction: Only input tokens at or before each prediction; targets never select predictions.
query_ignoring_modal.method: Mode of all visible value-token occurrences through this position; smallest-value tie break, default7. Current key is ignored.

model.latent_transitions: all within-example transitions, including native MAD padding
